name: Region 6: The Forbidden Domain
purpose: Background artwork for Region 6 of the Achievement World Map.
visual: Mysterious floating landmasses with ancient torii gates under a giant crimson eclipse moon.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration of an endgame world map region. Vast dark mysterious landscape with floating black stone islands, ancient torii gate silhouettes, enormous crimson eclipse moon in a pitch-black sky, dramatic negative space, clean vector edges, no anime, no 3D, no text.
